name: Logging Sensitive Data
diff:
diff --git a/logger.go b/logger.go
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/logger.go
@@ -5,0 +7,8 @@
+
+func login(db *sql.DB, username, password string) error {
+	log.Printf("Login attempt: user=%s pass=%s", username, password)
